description: Op-shaped job that force-cancels Dagster runs stuck in STARTING/STARTED/CANCELING beyond a threshold. Universal operational need — every deployment eventually gets zombie runs after worker crashes.

stuck_after_hours.label: Stuck After Hours
stuck_after_hours.description: Runs in-flight longer than this are candidates.

scan_limit.label: Scan Limit
scan_limit.description: Max in-flight runs to inspect per tick.

terminal_status.label: Terminal Status
terminal_status.description: CANCELED (default, cleanest) or FAILURE (to trigger alerting).

tags_filter.label: Tags Filter
tags_filter.description: Only inspect runs matching ALL these tag key/value pairs.

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: List stuck runs without changing status.
